dashboard_admin.pool_backing_attach_txid_description: The transaction id of the movement this settlement made. The engine resumes verifying it on the receiving side; nothing is settled until that side confirms.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_attach_txid_failed: Could not attach the transaction id
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_confirm_not_broadcast: I checked the chain and the exchange: this transaction was never broadcast
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_confirm_order_not_filled: I verified at the exchange that this conversion order was never placed, or was cancelled or rejected with nothing filled
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_confirm_exchange_not_honour: I verified at the exchange that this withdrawal was refused, cancelled or never created
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_confirm_dispatch_not_sent: I checked the source address on the chain: nothing was broadcast for this settlement
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_convert_disabled_none: No open conversion rows for this currency
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_convert_now_description: Place one market order on the exchange that acquires what it owes in this currency and never received (its open conversion rows). The engine sizes the order under the max settlement cap and the venue's minimums, books the venue fee as recognised loss, and refuses when the custody leg of the same transfer is not settled yet or the venue lists no market for the currency.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_custody_cache: The custody read cache as it stands now, which may be fresher than the reconciliation snapshot
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_direction_auto: Automatic (by the sign of the net obligation)
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_direction_eco_to_exchange: Custody → exchange (closes what the pool was short)
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_direction_exchange_convert: Exchange conversion (buys on the exchange what it owes and never received)
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_direction_exchange_to_eco: Exchange → custody (closes what the pool held in excess)
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_drift_streak_hint: Consecutive reconciliation runs the same unexplained residual has held; it becomes drift once it survives the configured number of runs.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_ecosystem_side_description: Per currency and chain: what the Funding wallets are owed on that chain against what the platform's custody addresses hold on-chain. The treasury, the master and the custodial contracts are read every reconciliation; customer addresses in a rotating slice, the rest from their cached figure. Custody holds is a live sum only when every address has a figure; otherwise the known part is shown with the read coverage and the oldest read. The mirror is the wallet table's own figure, not a chain read. The residual here is shown, never recorded as drift.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_ecosystem_unread: {currency}: the ecosystem side was not read in the latest reconciliation
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_engine_auto: Auto — the cron settles nettable obligations above the threshold
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_engine_description: The engine verifies every settlement in flight in every mode except off; it plans and dispatches new ones only from the cron in auto, or when you press Settle now in manual or auto. It refuses a currency whose last reconciliation is stale, unreadable, or carries unacknowledged drift, and it never resends a movement it cannot prove failed.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_engine_manual: Manual — settles only when you press Settle now
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_engine_monitor: Monitor — verifies what is in flight, moves nothing
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_failed_to_load: Failed to load the pool-backing summary
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_mark_arrived_description: You verified on the receiving side that the coins arrived. Enter what arrived and your proof; the difference to the requested amount is booked as recognised loss and the claimed obligations close.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_mark_arrived_failed: Could not mark the settlement as arrived
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_mark_failed_description: The movement never happened. Its obligations reopen for the next cycle and the row stays as the record of the attempt. Never mark a broadcast transaction failed: its coins would be settled twice.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_mark_failed_failed: Could not mark the settlement as failed
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_marked_failed: Settlement marked as failed; its obligations are open again
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_master_reserve_unknown: The master reserve names chains this install has no rail for: {chains}.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_master_reserve_unknown_hint: Those entries are kept but no signer will ever look them up. Use the chain name (ETH, BSC, TRON, SOL, XMR, ...) in Settings > Wallet > Pool backing > Master Reserve.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_mirror_hint: The wallet table's own figure — not a chain read, never used to decide anything
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_monitor_only_no_ecosystem: Monitor only — the Ecosystem addon is not installed
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_no_ecosystem_side: No ecosystem side was read in the latest reconciliation. It appears once a currency has Funding wallets with addresses and the reconciliation has read custody.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_no_refusals: Nothing was refused in the last cycle.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_nothing_reconciled_yet: Nothing has been reconciled yet. Run a reconciliation to read the exchange.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_obligations_description: One row per balance change that moved a number without moving coins. A positive amount means the exchange pool is short by it; a negative one means it holds more than it owes.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_page_description: What the exchange pool owes against what it holds, the transfers and admin credits that explain the gap, and the doors to settle or acknowledge them. Nothing on this page moves money.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_parallel_stores_description: Principals parked in stores that Spot funded — copy-trading binary allocations, investment and AI-investment plans, synthetic staking positions, forex accounts and plans, and the FX trading net — counted in liabilities since they must be paid back to Spot.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_planning_skipped: Planning skipped in the last cycle
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_proof_reference: Proof: transaction hash, exchange deposit id, or bank reference
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_record_external_description: You moved coins between the pools outside the platform — sent custody coins to the exchange, withdrew from the exchange to a custody address, or bought coins on the exchange to cover a fiat transfer. Record what arrived and its proof; the currency's open obligations of that direction are settled oldest first.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_sent_from_master: Sent from the master wallet, not the treasury
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_settle_disabled_mode: Switch the mode to manual or auto to settle by hand
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_settle_failed: Could not run the settlement cycle
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_settle_now_description: Run one engine cycle for this currency: verify what is in flight, then plan, claim and dispatch one settlement if the net obligation is above the threshold. Leave the direction and chain on automatic unless you know why not; the engine still refuses what it cannot prove.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_settlements_description: Every physical movement between the pools, engine-made or recorded by hand, with its transaction id and proof. A row needing review has doors: attach the transaction id the engine lost, mark it arrived on the receiving side's evidence, or mark it failed so its obligations reopen.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_settlements_in_flight: Settlements in flight or needing review
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_settlements_list_unavailabl: The settlement list could not be read; showing only the rows in flight from the summary.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_table_description: Per currency: what every Spot wallet is owed (plus withdrawals debited but not yet sent), what the exchange holds across its account types, the gap, the open obligations that explain it, and the residual nothing explains. Hover a figure for its split.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_treasury_description: The platform's own custody wallets, held by a system user that cannot sign in. Exchange → custody settlements are paid into these addresses; custody → exchange settlements are sent from them or from any custody address holding surplus. Balances are the database mirror, not a chain read.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_treasury_empty: No treasury wallet exists yet. One is created per currency on the first exchange → custody settlement.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_treasury_unavailable: The treasury could not be read.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_txid_placeholder: Transaction hash, or the txid the exchange reported
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_unacknowledged_drift_descri: A gap that no obligation explains has held for several reconciliations. Review where it comes from — exchange fees, deposit fees, rewards paid from the treasury — then acknowledge it here. Acknowledging settles nothing.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_unattributed_hint: Funding wallet balance the address map attributes to no chain; counted once per currency, never per chain
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_uncovered_hint: The Super Admin Spot wallet was short when the venue fee was booked; this part of the fee is still owed
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_waive_code_app: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.

dashboard_admin.pool_backing_waive_two_person: You created this obligation, so you cannot waive it. Ask another admin with the waive permission.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_waive_verify_description: Writing off money needs your second factor. Enter the code to confirm this waive; it authorises this obligation only.
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_waive_verify_failed: The code could not be verified
dashboard_admin.pool_backing_waived_total_hint: Obligations recognised as loss. They still explain the gap and are never settled.

ext_admin_ai_market-maker.needs_two_active_bots_detail: Na engine e gadrevi vakalailai e rua na bot cakacaka ni bera ni volitaki na maketi oqo. Vakacakacaka tale e dua e ra.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.neither_redis_nor_the_database_lease: E sega ni yaco rawa ki na Redis se ki na roa ni database lease, o koya sa nanuma kina na process oqo ni sa liutaka na engine me sega ni vakadinadinataki taumada. Sa dodonu oqo ke dua ga na process e cakacaka, ia ke tu tale e dua na backend process e cakacaka tale, ena nanuma talega ni sa liutaka: ena toso vakarua na isau ka ra volai vakarua na 1-miniti candle e vakadeitaki kina na binary options. Vakacakacaka ga e dua na backend process me yacova ni yaco rawa e dua na arbiter.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.no_bots_for_filter: Sega ni dua na bot e salavata kei na filter oqo.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.no_bots_yet: E sega ni tiko na bot ena maketi oqo. Era buli ena gauna e tekivu kina taumada na market maker.

ext_admin_ai_market-maker.price_left_the_range_detail: Ena taudaku ni range, ena kauta lesu na engine na isau ki na range, ka vakavuna me kila rawa vakalevu na cakacaka tarava. Vakalevutaka na range se vakayaviraka na iyalayala.

ext_admin_ai_market-maker.price_mode_hint: Na vu ni isau ni maketi oqo
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.price_mode_mirror_notice: Mirror does not generate a price. It republishes the reference every 15 seconds and quotes real pool liquidity around it, so the chart moves exactly as the reference does. Real liquidity is pinned to 100% - no bot-to-bot trades are printed - and the market stops quoting entirely whenever the reference feed goes stale.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.price_mode_mirror_notice_title: This market will publish the reference price
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.price_mode_mirror_short: The reference price IS this market's price
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.price_mode_no_symbol: Sega ni simbolo taudaku e vakatubora
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.prices_must_be_positive: Na isau ni iyalayala kei na range me cecere mai na zero
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.range_adequacy_warning: This range is only {sigmas} sigma wide for the configured volatility, so price reaches the containment leash often and moves near the bounds become predictable.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.range_explainer: Na sisitema e vakatawana tiko na isau ena loma ni ruku qo, ka kauta tale ki na ikalima e tautuki, sa qai vakarawarawataka na ruku lekaleka na kena kilai ni veisau.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.range_is_tracking_tolerance: While following an exchange this range is a tracking tolerance, not fixed bounds: it travels with the reference, and its width is how far price may stray from it. Narrower tracks more tightly.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.range_low_below_high: Na kena lailai ni ruku me lailai mai na kena levu ni ruku.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.range_unused_in_mirror: In Mirror mode the price is the reference, so neither the target nor the range contains it. They are kept only as a sanity bound: a reference more than 10x away from the target is refused as a mis-mapped symbol.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.ranked_worst_first: E vakadonuya mai na ca duadua e liu
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.real_liquidity_hint: {real}% ni ivakatau era biu ki na ivola ni ivakatau dina; {simulated}% era vakatakarakarataki ga ena maliwa ni bots.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.real_liquidity_pinned_in_mirror: Fixed at 100% in Mirror mode. Anything lower would print bot-to-bot trades at a copied public price, which is fabricated volume wearing a real price.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.rebalance_calculated: Sa wilika na kena gadrevi me vakaisosotaki
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.rebalance_executed: Sa vakayacori na vakaisosotaki ena ivola ni ivakatau
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.rebalance_explainer: Na kena wilika e sega ni veisautaka e dua na ka. Ia na kena vakayacori na veivoli, e volitaki na duiduri ena titobu dina e vakataqomaka ena ivakatau, ka na vakabekataki totolo ke rai vakalekaleka sara na ivola se ke na sivia na iyalayala ni veisau isau.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.rebalance_failed: E sega ni rawa na vakaisosotaki

ext_admin_ai_market-maker.roi_hint: Na kena talei na pool nikua, me vakatauvatani kei na ilavo taucoko a biuti ki loma.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.roster_hint: Na bots era buli na maketi qo

ext_admin_ai_market-maker.start_needs_pool: Sa lala na pool. Biuta na ilavo drodro ni bera na kena tekivu.

ext_admin_ai_market-maker.venue_eco_hint: Quotes a spot market. The maker holds base and quote inventory in its pool and funds every order from it.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.venue_futures_hint: Quotes a perpetual market. The maker posts margin from a futures wallet, and a fill opens a position that is marked and liquidated like any trader's.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.volatility_settings_hint: Na kena yawa kei na kena totolo ni vakatara na isau me veisau
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.volatility_threshold_hint: Na veivoli ena vakacegu ke veisau na isau ka sivia na {pct}% ena dua na gauna lekaleka.

ext_admin_ai_market-maker.withdrawal_done: Sa Oti na Kena Kauta Tale
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.withdrawal_failed: Na kauta tani ilavo e sega ni yaco
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.real_depth_floor_hint: Real quotes this market keeps resting on each side of the book. Quotes on a following market expire after five minutes, so without a floor the real book empties between trades while the displayed one still looks full. Trade flow builds depth above this; the pool balance still limits every quote. Set to 0 to let trade flow alone provide real depth.
ext_admin_ai_market-maker.platform_wallet_explainer: The Super Admin's wallet. Every pool deposit is taken from it and every withdrawal is paid back into it, whoever operates this market.

E sega ni dua na ka e volai, e sega ni dua na imeli e vakauti, ka sega ni dua na parametaki e kacivi — o koya na ka qo e wale ka taleitaki me cakava ena gauna e bulai kina na kena idusidusi.
ext_admin_ai_support.processes_empty_means_none: Oqo e dua na lisi vakadonui, ke lala e ibalebale sega ni dua. E sega ni dua e cakacaka me yacova ni o tekaki, ka na ka e kuria mai e dua na iVakavou ena kalawa ena vakatawani tiko me yacova ni o tekaki talega.
ext_admin_ai_support.processes_lede: E dua na iSasaga e kauta na kaliedi ena vica na vakadonui, e so na gauna ena vica na siga. Ia kabavu e cakava e dua na iCakacaka mai na lisi e cake, dolava e dua na tabana, se cakava e dua na ivakavuvuli — o koya na iSasaga e sega ni rawa ni cakava e dua na ka e sega ni rawa ni cakava e dua na iCakacaka duadua.
ext_admin_ai_support.processes_off_notice: Sa vakatawani tu na iSasaga, o koya na ka e tekaki e ra sega ni solia vua e dua na tamata. Na ka e tekaki e maroroi.

ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportAccountToolsEnabled: Rawa ni wilika na akaunede ni kasitama
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportDebounceMs_help: Ke vakauta e tolu na iVola vakadolavi e dua na kasitama, me duabau ga na isau e wilika kece na tolu, sega ni tolu na isau ka wilika yadua e dua ga na tikina.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportDraftOnBargeIn: Maroroya na isau vakarautaki ni dua e taura na iulutaga
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportDraftOnBargeIn_help: Ke dua na dauveiqaravi e taura na veivosaki ni se vola tiko na dauveivuke, maroroya na ka e vola me rawa ni vakayagataka.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportGroundednessFloor_help: Na isau e sega ni vakadeitaki na kena itukutuku dina ena dua na tikina vakadinadinataki, ena sega ni vakauti.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportLiveChatEnabled_help: E sega ni dua e vakatawataka na veivosaki vakalive me vakadonuya e dua na isau vakarautaki, o koya gona e rawa ga ni yaga ni sauma taucoko wale ga na dauveivuke.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportMaxTurnsBeforeEscalatio: Isau ni bera ni soli yani
Ni oti e vica na isau ni AI ena duabau na veivosaki, ena qai taura na iulutaga e dua na tamata.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportModel_help: E vakayagataki ni sega ni tiko e dua na imodeli i kena vakayagataki na dauveiqaravi.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportProactiveEnabled: Dolava e dua na tikite ni sega ni yaco e dua na isau lavo
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportProactiveEnabled_help: Ni sega ni yaco e dua na iVakauta se iVakalaui ni lavo, dolava e dua na tikite ka vakamacalataka na ka a yaco ka imeli vua na kasitama — ni bera ni raica ka veitalanoa vata kei kemuni. Oqo ga na ivakarau e vakavuna na dauveivuke me vakauta na itukutuku vua e dua na tamata a sega ni veitalanoa vata kei na yalayala ni veivuke, o koya gona e tara me yacova ga ni kemuni vakabulaitaka.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportRerankEnabled: Vakatorocaketaki tale na iwalewale ni vakasaqa
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportRerankEnabled_help: E dua na kena vakayagataki tale na imodeli sauti lailai e kunea na tikina dodonu ni duidui na vosa e vakayagataka na kasitama kei na ivola vakamacala. E lavo voleka ki na dua na iwase e lima ni cent ena isau yadua.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportRetentionDays: Maroroya na itukutuku ni AI ena (siga)
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportRetentionDays_help: Na kena balavu ni maroroi na itukutuku ni isau i kena vakataki na dauveivuke. Na nomu itukutuku ni tikite ena sega ni yaco kina.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportRetrievalFloor_help: Ke lailai mai na isevu oqo ena sega ni sauma vakadua na dauveivuke — ena kaya ni sega ni vola tu vua ka soli yani na iulutaga. Ke vakalevui ena vakadewataka na dauveivuke me lailai na kena vosa ka levu cake na kena dodonu.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportScopeToInstalledProduct: Sauma ga na iyaya sa vakayagataki
Vakatarai na dauveivuke ni vakamacalataka na iwiliwili o ni sega ni volitaka.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportTicketsEnabled_help: Vakatara me tarai kina na dauveivuke ni tara na tikite, ka sega ni vakatara taucoko ena veiyasana kece.
ext_admin_ai_support.setting_aiSupportTopK_help: E vica na ivola vakamacala e wilika na dauveivuke ni bera ni sauma. Ke levu, ena levu tale ga na kena lavo.
ext_admin_ai_support.step_up_required: Gadrevi e dua na ivakadeitaki karua
ext_admin_ai_support.stopping_does_not_undo: Na kena vakatarai ena sogota na icabecabe e se bera ni vakadonuya na kasitama. Na ka sa oti ena tiko ga me oti.
ext_admin_ai_support.subtitle: E dua na dauveivuke e saumi na tikite kei na veivosaki vakalive mai na nomu ivola vakamacala, ka soli yani vua e dua na tamata ena gauna e dodonu kina.
ext_admin_ai_support.super_admin_help: Na veika oqo era vakatulewa se dua na ipepiliesi caka i vakaitovo ena vosa vata kei na nomu kasitama, kei na levu ni kena lavo ena rawa ni vakayagataka. Era vakasamataki e ra dau vakaevei ena System → Settings ena dua na Super Admin.
ext_admin_ai_support.teach_failed: E Sega ni Rawa ni Buli e Dua na Ivakarau
ext_admin_ai_support.teach_from_ticket_help: Vakaisulutaka na veivosaki oqo me dua na ivakarau ni ivola ni veivuke. E vakalailaitaki taumada na tikite ka sega ni dua na gauna e tuvaki.
ext_admin_ai_support.test_failed: E sega ni rawa ni vakaotia na vakatovolena.
ext_admin_ai_support.test_retrieval_help: Runs the search without calling the model, so it costs nothing. This is how to find out why the assistant refused a question.
ext_admin_ai_support.test_retrieval_placeholder: kena ivakaraitaki, na cava e se waraki tiko kina noqu kauta tani ilavo?
ext_admin_ai_support.thinking_counts_against_this_so_a: Na vakasamataka e wilika ina oqo, o koya gona ena rawa ni vakayagataki oti na iyalayala lailai ena vakasama ka sega ni dua na ka e vakasukai. Vakatuni ina 4,000 se cake.
ext_admin_ai_support.title: Agedi ni Veivuke AI
ext_admin_ai_support.unanswered_stubs_note: {count} ni na taro ni vakavulici tale ena nomu ivolatabu ni kila e se lala tu. Na taro yadua ena vakabekataki ga na dauveivuke me yacova ni o saumi.
ext_admin_ai_support.uses_native_tour: E vakayagataka na nona isiko dina na tabana

ext_admin_ai_support.walkthroughs_empty_means_all: Na liste ni vakadonui oqo e cakacaka ena dua tale na sala. Kevaka e lala, e kena ibalebale me ratou vakadonuya kece, wili kina na so ena kena vakavou e muri mai — na veidusimaki e sega ni volai e dua na ka, o koya gona na ka vou e dua na ivakamacala vou ni dua na tabana o sa cakava oti, sega ni dua na kaukauwa vou.
ext_admin_ai_support.walkthroughs_lede: Na veidusimaki e kolia e dua na tabana e rawa ni kola oti tu na kena isiseva vakaitaukei ni kastama, ka vakaraitaka na iyaragi kece tu kina, e dua ga na isentesi ena dua na gauna. E sega ni volai e dua na ka, e sega ni vakasinaita e dua na ka, ka sega ni cakava e dua na ka ena vukui dua tale na tamata.
ext_admin_ai_support.walkthroughs_narrowed: {count, plural, one {Vakalekalekataki ki na veidusimaki #} other {Vakalekalekataki ki na veidusimaki #}}
ext_admin_ai_support.walkthroughs_off_notice: Sa vakabuqaia na veidusimaki, o koya gona e sega ni dua e soli. Ni vakayacoritaki tale, ena vakasavatataki tale na veika e vakadonuya e ra.
ext_admin_ai_support.walkthroughs_switched_off: Oya na veidusimaki fanuca e vakadonuya tu, o koya gona sa vakabuqaia oti na veidusimaki. Kevaka e na vakalailaitaki na kena tikiwau, ena volai e dua na liste lala, e kena ibalebale me kece kina.
ext_admin_ai_support.weak_passages: Ivola ni Itukutuku era Kaya na Nomu Kastama me Cala
ext_admin_ai_support.weak_passages_help: Na veitikina oqo era tu e mata ni dauveivuke ni dua e teva na susuva ca. Na liste ni vakuwa e cake oqo, oya na ka o se bera ni volaya; oya qo, na ka o volaya ka sega ni vinaka.
ext_admin_ai_support.what_to_fix_help: Na veivosaki kece e solia na dauveivuke vua e dua na tamata ena {days} na siga sa oti, kei na ka ena tarova me kua ni tukuni tale. Eso ni veika oqo, oya na ivakarau ni cakacaka vinaka — era vakatanumi na veika oya.
ext_admin_ai_support.why_this_reached_you: Na Vuna e Yacova Kina Iko
ext_admin_ai_support.workflows_subtitle: Na ka kece e rawa ni cakava na dauveivuke me vukei kina e dua na kastama, kei na levu ni ka o vakadonuya. Na ivalavala e volai e dua na ka; na isaralaki e dua na iwasewase ni ivalavala; na veidusimaki e sega sara ni volai e dua na ka.

ext_admin_dex.a_position_is_not_revenue_body: Oqo e dua na iyau e veisau na kena talei. E sega ni dua na ka ena tabana qo e yaco ki na ripoti ni tubu, ka e sega ni dua e vola me yacova ni vakadeitaki ka tavi laivi.

ext_admin_dex.accept_price_deviation: Au vakadonuya na veisau ni isau qo
ext_admin_dex.accrued_at_description: Ni vakadeitaki na veisau i-taki ka sauma na ilavo qo.
ext_admin_dex.accrued_not_swept_description: Tu ena nomu itikotiko ni taura ilavo
ext_admin_dex.accrued_vs_onchain_description: Na ka e kaya na neitou ivola ni tu ena veitikotiko ni taura ilavo, veivakatauvatani kei na ka e kaya na chain ni tu kina.
ext_admin_dex.acknowledgement_required: Wilika taumada na ivakasala ni leqa
ext_admin_dex.acknowledgement_required_body: E sega ni dua na leqa ni pool qo. Ni o vakayagataka ena vakavuna mo iliuliu ni liquidity kei na tokani ni veivoli nei ira na daumaqoli, ka sa dodonu me vakadeitaki qori ni bera ni yaco e dua na veisau ni liquidity.
ext_admin_dex.aggregators_missing_credential: {count} sa vakausui ia e sega ni dua na credential ena environment
ext_admin_dex.aggregators_on_subtitle: Adapters e rawa ni taroga na isau
ext_admin_dex.amount_base_units_description: Na uint256 dina me vaka ga ni vakaraitaki ena chain. Oqo na ivakamacala dina.
ext_admin_dex.amount_description: Ena iyaya token. Na idusidusi dina ni base-unit e tu ena laini e vakalevutaki.
ext_admin_dex.amount_precision_description: E vica na decimal e vakaraitaki kina na ilavo.
ext_admin_dex.an_adapter_has_to_be_switched_on_before_: E dodonu me vakabulabulataki taumada e dua na adapter ni bera ni vakaisosou e dua na ka. E sega ni dua na ka eke e taura tu e dua na key — e vakasuka mai e dua na route na aggregator, ka na wallet i koya ga na dauveiqaravi e vakadinadinataka.
ext_admin_dex.attention_first: Na chain e sega ni rawa ni vakasoqoni e vakaliutaki ena lisi
ext_admin_dex.availability_group_description: Ke vakarautaki na chain oqo me quote, kei na kena titobu me vakabekutaki taumada e dua na swap ni bera ni vakaotia.
ext_admin_dex.balances_truncated: Na position levu duadua ga era vakadikevi ena chain. Vakayacora e so vei ira qai vakavouta me vakadikevi kina na vo.
ext_admin_dex.binding_key_description: E dua na hash ni payload dina a soli vua na dauveiqaravi. Oqo e vakadinadinataka ni dua na transaction e broadcast-i sa dina me vaka na quote e tukuni.
ext_admin_dex.block_description: Na block e lako yani kina.
ext_admin_dex.bought_description: E vica na ka a taura na dauveiqaravi, ena buy token.
ext_admin_dex.break_even_volume_body: Ena {bps} bps vua na LP, oqo na volume e gadrevi me na fees me ubia kina na impermanent loss.
ext_admin_dex.break_even_volume_description: E vica na volume me lako ena pool me na fees me ubia kina na impermanent loss. E vakayagataka na share ni LP, sega ni fee tier.
ext_admin_dex.broadcast_at_description: Na gauna a vakauta kina na dauveiqaravi na transaction oqo.
ext_admin_dex.cannot_be_priced: E sega ni rawa ni vakaisosou — ka vakabekutaki, ka sega ni lako yani me vaka e zero.
ext_admin_dex.cannot_seed_yet: E se sega ni rawa ni seed-i na pool oqo
ext_admin_dex.chain_column_description: Yaca ni network kei na tikina ni path ni aggregator.
ext_admin_dex.chain_id_description: Na EVM chain id vakanumera — na vakatakilakila duabau e vakadeitaki ena veichain lisi kece ena platform.
ext_admin_dex.chain_not_in_registry: E sega ni dua na registry entry ni build oqo me baleta na chain oya, o koya gona e sega ni rawa ni dua e quote kina. Kauta laivi mai na scope.
ext_admin_dex.chain_scope_description: Na chain e vakadonuya na adapter oqo me quote kina. Ke lala, e sega ni dua na veivakatapui ka na coverage i koya ga na adapter ena vakayagataki.
ext_admin_dex.chain_scope_form_description: Vakaisosoya me lala vakavo ke o vinakata me vakatapui na adapter oqo. Na kena vakarogolevutaki na chain eke ena rawa ga ni vakalailaitaka na coverage, sega ni vakalevutaka.
ext_admin_dex.chain_status_description: Ke Off, e sega ni dua na quote, build se swap ena chain oqo, se cava ga era vakadeitaka na providers.
ext_admin_dex.chains_blocked_subtitle: E dua na ka e tarava e dua na swap
ext_admin_dex.chains_earning_nothing: {count} na chain sa vakabulabulataki ia era sega ni vakalevu e dua na ka
ext_admin_dex.chains_off_subtitle: Sa Vakarautaki ia E Sega ni Soli Vei Ira Na Dauveiqaravi
ext_admin_dex.chains_page_description: Na overlay ni dauveiliutaki ena dela ni chain registry sa tu vakaiyau. Na rows era vakavuna mai na code; na ka o vakarautaka eke oya na switch, na dua e vakarawa na fee, na RPC endpoints, kei na confirmation depth.
ext_admin_dex.chains_quote_only_description: Sa taviri, ia sa yali e dua na ka e gadrevi
ext_admin_dex.chains_ready_description: Sa vakadonuya taucoko na vakadikevi ni vakarau
ext_admin_dex.chains_ready_subtitle: Sa taviri ka sega ni dua na ka e tarova
ext_admin_dex.chains_with_a_fee_destination: Na chain kece e kila na build oqo
ext_admin_dex.check_enabled_off: Sa musuki — sega ni dua na ka ena chain oqo e vakarautaka na quote.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_earning: E kau na {bps} bps ki na address ena chain oqo.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_missing: Sega na address dina. Na swaps ena chain oqo era vakabekataki me yacova ni o vakarautaka e dua.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_set: E dua na address dina sa vakarautaki me baleti na chain oqo.
ext_admin_dex.check_fee_recipient_zero_ack: E cakacaka vakadodonu ena fee zero — sega e dua e gadrevi me vakarawa.
ext_admin_dex.check_rpc_missing: Sega e dua na RPC ena vakarautaki ena server me baleti na chain oqo.
ext_admin_dex.check_rpc_unverified: E vakarautaki mai na {source}, ia sega e dua na ka e vakadeitaka ni sauma ena chain id oqo.
ext_admin_dex.check_wallet_missing: Na build oqo e sega ni tiko kina e dua na ivakamacala ni wallet network me baleti na chain {chainId}, o koya, e sega ni rawa vua e dua na user me veisau ki kina. Kabora ki na wallet config qai REBUILD tale na frontend — na list e vakarautaki vakaraitaki ena loma.
ext_admin_dex.check_wallet_ok: Na wallet layer ena build oqo e rawa ni veisau ki na network oqo.
ext_admin_dex.chunks_failed: Na block ranges oqo era sega ni rawa ni wilika ka ra sivitaki: {ranges}. Cakava tale vakataki ira ga.
ext_admin_dex.confirmations_column_description: Na kena titobu na transaction oqo.
ext_admin_dex.confirmations_description: Na iwiliwili ni blocks e dodonu me titobu kina na swap transaction ni bera ni okati me vakaotia.
ext_admin_dex.connect_to_sign: Veisemati e dua na wallet me saini
ext_admin_dex.connect_to_sign_description: Na platform e sega ni taura e dua na key me baleti oqo. Na transaction kece e ra tu e ra vakauta mai na dua na wallet o dusia.
ext_admin_dex.could_not_be_settled: E sega ni rawa ni vakaotia
ext_admin_dex.could_not_be_settled_description: Na fee sa tu ena chain ka nomu ga se tiko. Na ka e vakalailaica na credit ki na nomu books.
ext_admin_dex.could_not_build_plan: Na plan e sega ni rawa ni tara.
ext_admin_dex.credential_description: Ke sa vakarautaki dina se sega na environment variable e wilika kina na adapter oqo na nona API key ena server oqo. Na key ga e sega ni vakaraitaki se maroroi eke.
ext_admin_dex.credential_missing_title: {envVar} sa sega ni vakarautaki ena server oqo, o koya, na quote kece ena adapter oqo ena sega ni rawa na authentication.
ext_admin_dex.default_slippage_description: Na slippage e dolava kina na market oqo, ena basis points.
ext_admin_dex.default_slippage_form_description: Biuta me lala me vakayagataki na global default. Vakalevutaka ga ni dua na market e mani lailai dina — na default cake e saumi na user kece ena veitrade taucoko.
ext_admin_dex.destination_address_help: Na vanua o vakauta kina na ilavo. Oqo na address duadua eda sega ni kila.
ext_admin_dex.difference_explainer: Na duidui POSITIVE e vinaka ga e levu na gauna: na fee recipient na nomu address ka rawa ni taura na nomu ilavo, ka rawa talega ni ibalebale e dua na fee eda sega ni vola. Vakayagataka na scan e ra me kunea kina. Na duidui NEGATIVE oya me cakacakataki: sa vola tu e dua na revenue e sega ni tu ena address, ka ibalebale e dua na sweep e cakava taucake ena console oqo, se dua na fee e sega ni yaco mai.
ext_admin_dex.direct_pool_only_description: Na token oqo e lako ena nomu pool ka sega ni soli vua e dua na aggregator.
ext_admin_dex.direct_pool_only_form_description: Vakayagataka me baleti e dua na token e sega ni tiko ena aggregator list. Na kena ibalebale, na users era na taura ga na price e rawa ni solia na nomu pool.
ext_admin_dex.each_will_fail_authentication_on_every_q: na quote kece e taroga ena sega ni rawa na authentication me yacova ni vakarautaki na variable.
ext_admin_dex.enabled_chains_all: Sega e dua na chain e digitaki, na kena ibalebale, na chain kece sa taviri ena chain console era rawa ni quote. Oqo na tiki dodonu ni levu na installs.
ext_admin_dex.enabled_chains_hint: Oqo e vakalailaica na ka e rawa ni quote. Na taviritaki ni chain me ON e duatani na control
ext_admin_dex.enabled_chains_restricting: Na chain {count} ga oqo era rawa ni quote, dina ga ni so tale era taviri ena chain console.
ext_admin_dex.endpoint_description: E dua na override ni adapter's default API host. Ke lala, e vakayagataki na dua e tu vakaiyau.
ext_admin_dex.endpoint_form_description: Vakarautaka ga oqo ke solia vei iko na vendor e dua na dedicated host. Na URL e sega ni yacovi eke ena vakatawana na quote kece ena adapter oqo.
ext_admin_dex.estimated_rows_title: So na rows ena tiki oqo era vakadidivi mai na quote, ka sega ni veisau kei na Transfer log.
ext_admin_dex.every_quote_is_refused_until_one_is_enab: Na quote kece e vakabekataki me yacova ni taviri e dua na adapter.
ext_admin_dex.every_swap_in_the_window_reached_a_termi: Na swap kece ena 24 na aua e oti sa yacova na tiki vakadeitaki, ka sega ni dua e tu se lai sivitaka na drop window.
ext_admin_dex.every_transfer_recorded: Na transfer kece ena range oqo sa vola oti.
ext_admin_dex.expires_description: Na gauna a mudu kina na kaukauwa ni price oqo.
ext_admin_dex.explorer_description: Na Block-explorer base URL e vakayagataki me veisemati na transactions.
ext_admin_dex.factory_description: Na contract e vakatara na pool oqo. Na trust anchor ni veika taucoko e tukuna me baleti koya.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_chains: E sega ni rawa ni load-taki na chain list.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_dashboard: E sega ni rawa ni load-taki na Swap dashboard.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_requirements: E sega ni rawa ni load-taki na requirements report.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_revenue: E sega ni rawa ni load-taki na revenue summary.
ext_admin_dex.failed_to_load_wallets: E sega ni rawa ni load-taki na fee wallets.
ext_admin_dex.failure_reason_description: Na vuna e sega ni vakaotia kina na credit ki na nomu ivola.
ext_admin_dex.featured_description: Vakadeitaki ki na imatai ni liwa ni ivakarau ni bazaa.
ext_admin_dex.featured_form_description: Na bazaa vakaraitaki era basika e cake mai vei ira era vo tale ena ivakavolai.
ext_admin_dex.fee_accrual_description: E dua na roqorogo ena veivoli e taura ena chain, vakavulawa kina na roqorogo negative e volai ni sa dua na block e vakalailaitaki tale (reorged). Wilika ga: oqo na veika e raici ena chain, sega ni veika o rawa ni vola.
ext_admin_dex.fee_bps_description: Na voli ni platform e vakayagataki ena veivoli oqo, ena basis points.
ext_admin_dex.fee_group_description: Na vanua e yaco kina na voli ni integrator ena chain oqo. E sega ni tiko e dua na fallback vakavuravura — e dua na chain kei na voli ni platform ka sega ni dua na dau tauri e vakabesetaka na iwilivoli.
ext_admin_dex.fee_mode_description: Na yasana ni veivoli e rawa ni taura kina na router oqo na voli ni platform. E dua na ka ni kontraki ni vendor, sega ni dua na isetiwa.
ext_admin_dex.fee_recipient_description: Adresi e taura kina na voli ni integrator ena chain oqo. Koya na dau taura ni network oqo, sega ni dua na ka e vakabesetaka e dua tale na ka.
ext_admin_dex.fee_recipient_form_description: E dua na adresi o dusimaka. E vakadinadinataki me EIP-55 checksummed ka vakabulubulutaki ena itukutuku lailai; na adresi zero e sega ni vakadonui baleta ni na kama na veivoli kece.
ext_admin_dex.fee_revenue_description: Na ka sa rawata na nomu swap desk ena chain, na ka o sa taura, kei na vanua erau sega ni veiduavata.
ext_admin_dex.fee_status_description: Ke rawa na swap ena chain oqo me vakaotia ka rawata na isoli. E sega ni tautauvata kei na Vakayagataki: e rawa me vakayagataki e dua na chain ia e se vakabesetaka tiko na iwilivoli kece.
ext_admin_dex.fee_tier_form_description: Gadrevi ena V3, ni na voli sa yavu ni identity ni pool. Taura mai na deployment ena V2.
ext_admin_dex.fee_wallets_description: Na vanua e yaco kina na voli ni platform ena veichain, kei na kena rawa ni yaco dina kina. E dua na adresi EVM e taura na token kece ena sega ni dua na isetiwa; ena Solana e gadrevi vei ira na token yadua e nona account taumada.
ext_admin_dex.fees_earned_approx_description: Taura mai na tubu ni tikina, sa rauta ga ena kena tara.
ext_admin_dex.fees_not_bookable: Voli e Sega ni Rawa me Vola
ext_admin_dex.find_unrecorded_fees: Vaqara na Voli e Sega ni Volai
ext_admin_dex.find_unrecorded_fees_description: E dua na dauveiqaravi e sogota na tab ni oti nona saini e sauma tiko na voli, ia e sega ni volai e dua na ka. Vakadikevataka e dua na block range me vaqara kina na isolisoli ki na nomu dau taura voli ka sega ni dua na swap e tu ena kena tuba.
ext_admin_dex.gas_cost_description: Na ka a sauma na dauveiqaravi ki na network, ena dola.
ext_admin_dex.i_accept_and_take_the_position: Au vakadonuya ka taura na tikina
ext_admin_dex.if_you_had_held_description: Na levu vata e rua, e sega sara ni vakauti ena pool.
ext_admin_dex.impermanent_loss_description: Vakatakilakilataki na ka +/-. Na leqa ni bulubulu e vakatauvatani kei na taura, ka na isau ni voli e volekati kina.
ext_admin_dex.impermanent_loss_stat_description: Na isau ni rawa mai na voli oya. E sega ni dua na gauna vinaka.
ext_admin_dex.in_house_wallets_description: Adoption of the in-house Web3 wallet. Counts only — the platform stores an encrypted backup it cannot open, and keeps no list of customer addresses.
ext_admin_dex.largest_position_description: Na balance e sega ni tavi e levu duadua
ext_admin_dex.last_error_description: Na sega ni yaco muri duadua e vola na adapter oqo. E ka makawa — e sega ni vakabulai wale, o na dikeva taumada na timestamp ni bera ni cakava e dua na ka.
ext_admin_dex.last_screened_description: Na gauna e vakadikevi muri kina na token oqo ena ka e cakacaka wale.
ext_admin_dex.last_verified_description: Na gauna e sauma vakavinaka muri kina na adapter oqo e dua na vakatovolei.
ext_admin_dex.lifecycle_stat_description: Buli → Tea → Vakacegu. Na ACTIVE ga e rawa ni vakaisautaki.
ext_admin_dex.liquidity_positions_description: Na liquidity a solia na operator, kei na kena vinakati se sega ni cake na kena solia mai na kena taura wale ga na token e rua.
ext_admin_dex.listing_description: Nomu vakatulewa ni curation. E sega ni dua na ka e cakacaka wale e vakasamataka na ka oqo — dua ga na tamata e cakava.
ext_admin_dex.listing_form_description: Na token era vakadonui era rawa ni veisauma. Na Vakatawani na sala o vakacegua kina e dua na token: e tiko ga kina me rawa ni wilikitaki na veisauma makawa.
ext_admin_dex.logo_url_form_description: Vakaraitaki ena batina ni ticker. Biuta blank me lesu ki na icon lasi ni coin.
ext_admin_dex.lp_share_form_description: Biuta blank me vakatovolei mai na protocol-fee switch ni factory. E sega ni default sara ki na fee tier.
ext_admin_dex.market_column_description: Ivakatakilakila ni bazaa, kei na iyau vakaisau ena ruku.
ext_admin_dex.market_data_description: Na vanua e lako mai kina na chart ni bazaa oqo kei na isau muri.
ext_admin_dex.market_quote_description: Na ka e vakaisautaki kina na bazaa oqo.
ext_admin_dex.market_risk_acknowledgement_description: Version {version}. Na clause yadua e vakadonui vakaitani, ka na vosa dina e ruku oqo na ka e volai — ke veisautaki, na tea ena tarova me vakadeitaki tale.
ext_admin_dex.market_symbol_description: Vakaoti kina na chain id ena inaki — na veiwati vata e tu ena vica na network, ka ke na ivakatakilakila wale ga ena vakatawa na chart kei na isau feed me rau veiduavata na cava e dodonu.
ext_admin_dex.n_accrual_rows_awaiting_a_sweep: {count, plural, =0 {Sega ni dua na ka e waraki me tavi} one {# accrual e waraka me tavi} other {# accruals era waraka me tavi}}
ext_admin_dex.n_advisory_items: {count, plural, one {# ka ni ivakasala} other {# veika ni ivakasala}}
ext_admin_dex.n_fee_rows_could_not_be_collected: {count, plural, one {# laini ni isau e sega ni rawa ni vakasoqoni} other {# laini ni isau e sega ni rawa ni vakasoqoni}}
ext_admin_dex.n_rows_could_not_be_priced: {count, plural, one {# laini e sega ni rawa ni saumi} other {# laini e sega ni rawa ni saumi}}
ext_admin_dex.n_rows_credited: {count, plural, =0 {E sega ni dua na ka e saumi tiko} one {# laini e saumi} other {# laini e saumi}}
ext_admin_dex.n_swaps_are_past_the_drop_window: {count, plural, one {# swap sa sivi na drop window ka se vakatalatala tiko} other {# swaps era sa sivi na drop window ka era se vakatalatala tiko}}
ext_admin_dex.n_swaps_could_not_be_priced: {count, plural, one {# swap e sega ni rawa ni saumi} other {# swaps era sega ni rawa ni saumi}}
ext_admin_dex.native_asset_description: Na kena coin dina na chain, sega ni dua na contract — ETH, BNB, SOL, TRX.
ext_admin_dex.native_description: Na ticker ni ilavo gas dina ni chain.

overview.title: Raraba
overview.description: Per-chain readiness: what is enabled, what can quote, and what is still missing a fee recipient, a provider or a working RPC.

routing.title: Isala
routing.description: Na aggregators e kau mai kina na quotes, kei na chains era vakadonuya me ra quote kina.

providers.title: Dauveisolisoli
providers.description: Na adapters ni aggregator: vakabulai, iliuliu, chains e vakataravi, kei na env var e wilika kina na nona credential e dua na ka.

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: Switch ni chain yadua, dauvakarawa ni isau, RPC endpoints kei na vakadeitaki e gadrevi.

listings.title: iVolavola
listings.description: Na ka e vakadonuya vei ira na tamata me ra swap-i, kei na kena vakatatani.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Na iVolavola ni token e vakadonuya, kei na kena vakadidike, ivakatakilakila ni leqa, kei na on/off ni token yadua.

pairs.title: Veiwatini
pairs.description: Veiwatini ni volitaki e vakaraitaki tale ga kei na vakatarovi, e basika ena swap terminal.

activity.title: iTavi
activity.description: Na ka era cakava dina na users: quotes e solisolitaki, swaps e vakauta ki na chain, kei na isau ni integrator e vakalevutaki mai na swaps oya.

swaps.title: Swaps
swaps.description: Na ledger ni swap kei na kena tiko ena chain, transaction hashes kei na links ni block-explorer.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Quotes e solisolitaki, na provider e qaqa ena route yadua, kei na vuna era sega ni qaqa kina eso tale.

fees.title: iSau
fees.description: iSau ni integrator e vakalevutaki ena chain kei na token yadua, kei na sweeps e vakasoqoni kina.

settings.title: iVakarau
settings.description: iSwitch levu, kena tuvatuva ni isau, ilavo ni quote, taqomaki ni token, muria vakalawa kei na execution poller.

liquidity.title: Loga Ilavo
liquidity.description: Na veiloga e vakayagataka na sisitema qo me kena ivakarau ni isau, kei na ituvatuva e taura tu kina na dauveiliutaki.

pools.title: Veiloga
pools.description: Na ivola ni veiloga: na gauna ni bula, na vakadeitaki vou, na titobu, kei na calldata me buli se vakavulici kina e dua.

positions.title: Ituvatuva
positions.description: Net ena vakatauvatani kei na Taura, na ivola ni iyau-isau kei na ca e sega ni tudei ena loga ni ilavo e solia na dauveiliutaki. E sega ni volai me isau.

requirements.title: Veika Gadrevi
requirements.description: Na ka e se gadrevi tale ga vei ira na chain yadua ni bera ni rawa ni cakacaka e dua na veisosomi, kei na dua na vakadikevi bulabula e veivosaki kei na chain ka sega ni vakabauta wale ga na ivakarau.

wallets.title: Sotu Ilavo
wallets.description: Na vanua e yaco kina na isau ni sisitema ena chain yadua, kei na kena rawa dina ni yaco kina. E gadrevi vei Solana e dua na token account ena mint yadua; e sega ni gadrevi na EVM address e dua na ka.

userwallets.title: User wallets
userwallets.description: How many customers created an in-house wallet, and how many have backed up their recovery phrase. Counts only — the platform holds no key and stores no address list.

ext_admin_dex.need_attention_subtitle: Sa Tucake ia E sega ni Rawa ni Vakasoqoni
ext_admin_dex.net_vs_hold_description: Na isau ni vakalailaitaki ena ca e sega ni tudei. Ke negative, e vinaka cake me taura ga.
ext_admin_dex.no_aggregator_is_configured: Sega ni Dua na Aggregator e Vakarautaki
ext_admin_dex.no_aggregator_is_switched_on: Sega ni Dua na Aggregator e Tucake
ext_admin_dex.no_chain_is_collecting_body: Vakatucaketaka e dua na chain ka solia vua e dua na dauvakarawa isau. Ke o sega ni cakava, ena vakabekataki na veisosomi kece ena chain oya ni se cake tu na isau ni sisitema mai na zero.
ext_admin_dex.no_chain_is_collecting_yet: Sega ni Dua na Chain e se Vakasoqona tu na Isau
ext_admin_dex.no_chains_description: Na chain registry e vakatekivutaki ena imatai ni tekivu (boot). Ke tiko ga me lala, na laini ni extension Web3 Wallet & On-Chain Trading e se tawavakayagataki tiko.
ext_admin_dex.no_chains_wallet_body: E tuvana e dua na dau vakauta ni fee ena chain yadua, o koya mo vakayagataka taumada e dua na chain ni bera ni o rawa ni dusia e dua ki na vanua.
ext_admin_dex.no_chains_yet: Sa sega ni volai na chains se bera. Era vakatekivutaki mai na code registry ena imatai ni tekivu.
ext_admin_dex.no_events_yet: Sega ni volai na events se bera.
ext_admin_dex.no_fee_recipient_set: Sega ni tuvana e dua na dau vakauta ni fee — na chain oqo ena vakabiuta na quote ni se levu cake na fee ni platform mai na zero.
ext_admin_dex.no_fees_on_this_chain: Sega ni tauri na fees ena chain oqo se bera
ext_admin_dex.no_keys_here: Na addon oqo e sega ni taura na private keys
ext_admin_dex.no_keys_here_body: E duidui mai na ecosystem master wallets, na Swap e sega ni rawa ni bulia se import-taka e dua na wallet — e sega ni saini e dua na ka. Tuvana na address o sa dredre tu kina me dau vakauta ni fee ena chain yadua; na platform ena vakaraitaka wale ga e dua na transaction me saini na nomu wallet.
ext_admin_dex.no_positions_yet: Sega ni tiko na liquidity positions se bera.
ext_admin_dex.no_solana_chain_enabled: Sega ni vakayagataki e dua na Solana chain, o koya sa sega kina ni tiko e dua na token account me dikevi.
ext_admin_dex.no_swap_needs_attention: Sega ni dua na swap e gadreva na kauaitaki
ext_admin_dex.no_unswept_fees: Sega ni fees se bera ni tauri. Na ka kece sa rawati oti sa tauri kece.
ext_admin_dex.non_custodial_banner: Sega ni Vakatawa · sega ni taura e dua na key, sega ni saini e dua na ka eke
ext_admin_dex.not_configured_yet: Se bera ni ripotitaki na build oqo.
ext_admin_dex.not_set_up_yet_caption: Sa bokoci, ka sega e dua na dauvakawati ni isau. Sega na ka me kumuni se vakadodonutaki.
ext_admin_dex.nothing_checks_which_contract_a_user_sig: Sega e dua na ka e dikeva na kantirakiti e kerei vua na dauveiqaravi me sainitaka
ext_admin_dex.nothing_has_been_quoted_yet: Sega ni dua na isau e vakatakila ena 24 na aua sa oti
ext_admin_dex.nothing_has_settled_in_the_last_24_hours: Sega ni dua na ka e vakaotia ena 24 na aua sa oti
ext_admin_dex.nothing_quoted_in_the_last_24_hours: Sega na isau e vakatakila ena 24 na aua sa oti
ext_admin_dex.on_chain_events_description: Ia veimint, veiburn kei na veikumuni kece e volai ena qo na tikina, kei na risiti e tu ena kena tuba.
ext_admin_dex.on_solana_a_token_is_held: Ena Solana, na tokeni e taura ena dua na akaunite e taukena na nomu iyau taucoko — e dua ga vakaiyatokeni. Me vakadewa e liu ni na isau ena tokeni oya e rawa ni kumuni. Na buli ni dua e sau rauta ena 0.002 SOL me isau ni kena vakayagataki, ka vakasukai ke sa sogotaki.
ext_admin_dex.only_a_super_admin_can_change_this_setti: Ko koya duadua na Super Admin e rawa ni veisautaka na ka qo. Kerei e dua me vakayacora na veisau, se me solia vei iko na itavi qo ena nomu akaunite.
ext_admin_dex.open_positions_description: Na veitikina era se tu tiko na liquidity ena pool.
ext_admin_dex.operator_seeded_description: E vakatikari mai na dauvakawati on-chain ni liquidity, sega ni mai na foromu. Ke dina, na dauveiqaravi kece era vakatakila na wati qo era vakatakilai ni sa opereta na so tale.
ext_admin_dex.outcome_description: Se dua na isau e vakabulia se sega. Oqo na kolamu e vakamacalataka na dauveiqaravi e kaya ni na swap e sega ni cakacaka vua.
ext_admin_dex.overview_description: Per-chain readiness for non-custodial swaps. A chain has to be switched on, have a fee recipient, be covered by a credentialled aggregator and answer on its own RPC before it can quote.
ext_admin_dex.pair_chain_description: Na network e veivoli kina na maketi qo.
ext_admin_dex.pair_liquidity_description: Na titobu ni maketi qo, ena dola, me vaka a vakalatilatitaki tale mai.
ext_admin_dex.pair_presentation_group_description: Na sala e vakaraitaki kina na inumba, kei na vanua e vakarautaki kina na maketi.
ext_admin_dex.pair_routing_group_description: Na sala e kumuni kina na fills ni maketi qo. Ke veisautaki oqo, ena veisautaki tale ga na isau era rawata na dauveiqaravi.
ext_admin_dex.pair_status_description: Se sa vakarogoci, vunitaki, se biu tale na maketi qo.
ext_admin_dex.pair_status_form_description: Na Vunitaki e vakatawana me cakacaka tiko ga na maketi vei ira era volai ena link dodonu, ia ena kau tani mai na lisi. Na Delisted ena biu tale na maketi.
ext_admin_dex.pair_visibility_group_description: Se ena basika na maketi qo kei na vanua e basika kina.
ext_admin_dex.pairs_page_description: Na maketi o vakaraitaka — vakatabani, vakauta ena stream, ka vakarautaki ena ivakavolivoli. Na wati e ivakaraitaki ga, sega ni veivakadonui: rua na tokeni era tiko ena allowlist era se rawa ni veisau se sega ni dua na wati.
ext_admin_dex.picker_order_description: Na vanua e tu kina na tokeni qo ena swap picker. Na lailai ena liu.
ext_admin_dex.picker_order_form_description: Na inumba lalai era basika taumada. Na majors e vakatekivutaki era tomana vaka-native, wrapped, qai stablecoins.
ext_admin_dex.plus_unpriced: Kei na {count} tiki eda a sega ni rawa ni wilika na kena isau
ext_admin_dex.pool_address_description: E buli mai na factory ena nona lako yani ka lako tale mai, e sega ni taura mai na ka e vakauta. E lala ni se draft tiko na pool.
ext_admin_dex.pool_column_description: Na vanua e taukena kina na pool oqo kei na itovo e muria. Na itovo e vakatulewa na wiliwili, na foliga ni calldata, kei na kena rawa ni vakarautaki na isau.
ext_admin_dex.pool_create_economics_description: Na ka dina e rawata na tiki, ka sega ni ka e sauma na dau veisau.
ext_admin_dex.pool_create_pair_description: E rawa na iotioti e rua — na ivakarau dina e vakayagataki ena server, ka wilikitaki vakalevu me veibasai kei na nomu vakasama me baleta na veiwatini.
ext_admin_dex.pool_create_where_description: Na chain kei na tudei ni AMM. Na factory ga e sa vakabauti taumada ena qito oqo e rawa ni digitaki; na kena kalavotaki e dua na veisau ena chain-console.
ext_admin_dex.pool_detail_description: {venue} · {standard}. Na ivakayagayaga yadua e tu e ra e calldata e buli eke ka volavola taucoko kina o iko, mai na nomu wallet.
ext_admin_dex.pool_liquidity_description: Na yasayasa rua e vakatakilai ena dola. Ke lala, e kena ibalebale ni na reserves e sega ni rawa ni wilika na kena isau — ka vakabekataka na quote ni sega ni lako yani me vaka ni sivia.
ext_admin_dex.pool_not_found: Sa sega tale ni tu na pool oya.
ext_admin_dex.pool_rejection_description: Na vuna e vakabekataka kina na ivakadeitaki muri, ke a yaco.
ext_admin_dex.pool_state_description: Na kena yawa ena gauna ni buli → tea → vakavotu ni pool oqo. E duatani mai na ivakadeitaki: na quoting e gadrevi rau vata.
ext_admin_dex.pool_token_form_description: Na itikotiko ni token contract ena chain oqo.
ext_admin_dex.pool_verified_description: Na gauna e vakadeitaka kina e dua na factory e vakabauti ni itikotiko oqo na pool ni token oqo. Sa mudu na quoting ni sa makawa.
ext_admin_dex.pools_page_description: Na AMM pools e vinakata na qito oqo me quote mai kina. Na kena vakaroti e dua na pool e vola ena factory sa vakadonuya — e sega ni tudeitaka e dua na ka, ka na DRAFT se na CREATED erau sega ni rawa ni quotable.
ext_admin_dex.position_detail_description: {venue} · {standard}. Na ilavo dina e curu vaka veibasai kei na ilavo dina e curu tani, qai na ka kece sa vakatakilai mai na pool ga.
ext_admin_dex.position_not_found: Sa sega tale ni tu na tiki oya.
ext_admin_dex.position_open_tx_description: Na receipt e vola kina na tiki oqo.
ext_admin_dex.position_opened_description: Na gauna e vakadeitaki kina na receipt ni tea.
ext_admin_dex.position_owner_description: Na wallet e taura tiko na tiki oqo. E sega ni taura na qito na kii ni wallet oqo.
ext_admin_dex.position_pool_description: Na pool e tiko kina na liquidity oqo.
ext_admin_dex.position_state_description: KATUBA, VAKALAILAI, SOGO — se SA YALI, ni sa yali na receipt ni katuba ena dua na reorg.
ext_admin_dex.positions_table_description: Na ledger ni quote-asset e liu. Na impermanent loss e muri, ka na gauna ga e tu kina e dua na isau tudei.
ext_admin_dex.price_impact_description: Na kena yawa e na vakayagi na veivoli oqo na pool, ena basis points.
ext_admin_dex.price_precision_description: Na levu ni decimals e vakaraitaki kina na isau.
ext_admin_dex.prices_render_and_nothing_executable_is_: Na isau era se vakaraitaki tiko ka sega ni buli e dua na ka e rawa ni vakayacori. Oqo na kill switch, sega ni cala ni ivakarau — e dua na operator e cavuta vakadodonu e sega ni vakacacana e dua na ka.
ext_admin_dex.priority_description: Na iotioti erau tovolea kina na adapters. Na wiliwili lailai e qaqa ke rau vakasuka e rua na route tautauvata.
ext_admin_dex.priority_form_description: Na wiliwili lailai era tovolei taumada. E rawa me rua adapters me wiliki vata — na cava e sauma vinaka cake e qaqa.
ext_admin_dex.probe_failed: E dua wale ga na ivakadidike e sega ni yacova
ext_admin_dex.probe_passed: Na ivakadidike kece era sa saumi
ext_admin_dex.provider_column_description: Na yaca ni vendor e vakaraitaki, kei na registry key e ra. Na key oya e vauci na row ki na kena vakayacori.
ext_admin_dex.provider_description_description: Na ka e aggregator oqo kei na vanua e route kina.
ext_admin_dex.provider_routing_group_description: Ke vakayagataki na aggregator oqo, kei na vanua e tiko kina ena iotioti ni cakacaka.
ext_admin_dex.provider_scope_group_description: Na iVakatarogi e sega ni vakabibiti. Na yasayasa rua erau vinaka me biu duadua ena install e dei.
ext_admin_dex.provider_status_description: Ke rawa ni kau mai na quotes ena aggregator oqo.
ext_admin_dex.provider_status_form_description: Na kena vakamatei e vakamuduka sara ga na quotes vou. Na swaps sa broadcast oti era sega ni yaco kina ka era se vakayacori tiko.
ext_admin_dex.provider_title_description: Na kena vakayacani na aggregator oqo ena console.
ext_admin_dex.providers_page_description: Na aggregator kece e rawa ni vakayagataki na build oqo me kauta na isau. E tu e dua na adapter ena kod ka tawayagataki me yacova ni o vakayagataka; ke vakayagataki e dua na adapter ka sega ni tiko na credential ena sega ni solia e dua na isau ka na rairai bulabula tale ga, oqori na vuna erau vakaraitaki vata kina na ka rua.
ext_admin_dex.public_rpc_description: Na RPC ena vakadewa (browser). Na ka oqo ena yaco ki na milimili ni dauveiqaravi, o koya gona e sega ni dodonu me kauta e dua na key.
ext_admin_dex.quote_aggregator_description: Na cava na aggregator e kauta na route oqo.
ext_admin_dex.quote_asset_delta_description: Ilavo dina e curu kei na ilavo dina e lako yani, ena token ni isau. Na ulutaga levu, baleta ni sega ni tiko kina na isau veitokoni.
ext_admin_dex.quote_asset_ledger_body: Na ilavo duadua ga ena tabana oqo ka sega ni tiko kina na isau veitokoni. Ena token ni dauveiliutaki, ena rawa ni vakarua na ca mai na ka e tukuni ena laini ni impermanent-loss.
ext_admin_dex.quote_chain_description: Na network cava na isau oqo e baleti.
ext_admin_dex.quote_fee_bps_description: Na isau ni platform e vakaraitaki, ena basis points.
ext_admin_dex.quote_status_description: Na ka e yaco ki na isau ni sa solia oti.
ext_admin_dex.quote_user_description: O cei e kerea na isau oqo.
ext_admin_dex.quote_value_description: Na levu ni veisau isau e vakaraitaki, ena dola.
ext_admin_dex.quotes_page_description: Na isau kece e solia, wili kina o ira era sega ni yaco dina. Na platform oqo e sega ni taura na ilavo, o koya gona na roqoroqo oqo na itukutuku duadua ga ni ka e solia, vei cei, kei na lawa e vakayagataki kina — oqori na vuna e rawa kina me sauma na 'Au sega ni rawata rawa e dua na isau.'
ext_admin_dex.range_unknown: Na Tikina e Sega ni Rawa ni Wilika
ext_admin_dex.range_unknown_body: Na tick ni pool oqo ena gauna oqo e sega ni rawa ni wilikitaki, o koya gona e sega ni kila se dua na position oqo e vakarautaka e dua na isau se sega.
ext_admin_dex.readiness_no_recipient: Sega ni Tiko na Dauvakila Isau
ext_admin_dex.readiness_unavailable: Sa Sega ni Rawa na Vakarautaki ni Chain
ext_admin_dex.readiness_unverifiable: E Sega ni Rawa ni Vakadinadinataki
ext_admin_dex.ready_to_collect_subtitle: E tu na itikotiko ka rawa ni ciqoma
ext_admin_dex.ready_to_seed_body: Sa vinaka na ka kece ka sa saini na itukutuku ni leqa ni maketi. Na veisau ilavo e ra tu e ra e nomu me vakauta.
ext_admin_dex.reason_credit_failed: Na credit ki na waleti e sega ni yaco vakalima. Na veisau ilavo e vakadeitaki ena chain; dikeva na log ni isau ni platform me kila na cala dina.
ext_admin_dex.reason_currency_not_registered: Na token oqo e sega ni tiko ena nomu liste ni ilavo, o koya gona e sega ni tiko e dua na waleti e rawa ni vakayagataki na platform me credit kina. Vakacurumi na ilavo, qai vakatani tale na sweep.
ext_admin_dex.reason_rounds_to_zero: Na isau e vakarauta ki na zero ena precision ni ilavo oqo. Vakayagataka e dua na isau levu, se vakalevutaka na precision ni ticker oqo.
ext_admin_dex.receiving_wallet_description: E dua na waleti o taura vakataki iko. Na waleti ni platform era vakabekataki: na custodial treasury e sega ni dodonu me taura e dua na position ni maketi.
ext_admin_dex.reconcile_failed: Na scan e sega ni rawa ni vakaotia.
ext_admin_dex.record_sweep_description: Tukuna vua na platform e dua na veisau ilavo o sa cakava oti, me rawa ni keimami vakadinadinataka kei na chain ka credit na nomu ivola.
ext_admin_dex.registry_key_description: Na ivakatakilakila e vakayagataki na router me kunea na kod ni adapter oqo. Sa vakadeitaki — na vakayacataka tale ena vakasegataka na roqoroqo me sega ni dusia rawa e dua na ka.
ext_admin_dex.requirements_description: Na ka e vinakati tiko vei ira na chain yadua ni bera ni rawa ni solia e dua na swap, kei na probe e veivosaki kei na chain ka sega ni vakabauta ga na ka e volai. E sega ni tiko e dua na ka ena wale ga vakaisausau: na iyaya karakarawa yadua e dua na ka sa vakarautaki, ka na Test e vakadinadinataka na kena sauma.
ext_admin_dex.restricted_countries_description: E vei na vanua e sega ni solia kina na maketi oqo.
ext_admin_dex.restricted_countries_form_description: Na dauveiqaravi ena veivanua oqo era na sega ni raica na maketi oqo. Biuta me lala me solia ena veivanua kece e vakadonuya kina nomu lawa vakavuravura.
ext_admin_dex.revenue_by_chain_description: Kena Levu ni Isau ena Bula Taucoko ni Network Yadua
ext_admin_dex.risk_description: Na vakatulewa vakayacori automatic. Ena volai tale ena vakadikevi muri, o koya gona vakayagataka na Listing me vola e dua na vakatulewa o vinakata me tu dei.
ext_admin_dex.risk_flags_description: Na ka e vakalasuya na vakadikevi, ena nona vosa.
ext_admin_dex.risk_form_description: Na vakadodonutaka e dua na false positive eke ena tu ga me yacova na vakadikevi muri. Me vakadeitaki tawamudu, vakatuni na Listing me sostiti.
ext_admin_dex.routed_through_description: Na aggregator se pool cava e vakavuna na route oqo.
ext_admin_dex.router_description: Na target ni swap kei na dauvakayagataki ni ERC-20.
ext_admin_dex.rpc_group_description: E rua na field vakaduiduitaki ena vakasama: e dua ga na field me baleti rau na sala e curu kina e dua na URL vakakeytaki ki na JavaScript bundle.
ext_admin_dex.rpc_source_env: na variable ga ni addon oqo
ext_admin_dex.scan_writes_nothing: Wilika-ga. Na scan oqo e sega ni veisautaka e dua na ka.
ext_admin_dex.seed_this_pool_description: Na ilavo kei na wallet ena taura na tiki. Na veika kece tale — na router, na factory, na ivakarau ni token, na tick range — e vakatakila mai eke ka sega ni taura mai na tabana oqo.
ext_admin_dex.sender_description: Na wallet e sainitaka, e wilika mai na chain ka sega ni taro ga mai na client.
ext_admin_dex.served_at_description: Na gauna e soli kina na isau oqo.
ext_admin_dex.server_rpc_description: Kevaka e vakarautaki e dua na RPC ena vo ni server, kei na vanua e lako mai kina. Na URL e sega ni talai mai eke — Alchemy kei Infura erau vakacuru na API key ena path.
ext_admin_dex.server_rpc_form_description: Server-side RPC, e volatani ga mai na screen oqo: e rawa ni vakacuru e dua na provider key, o koya gona e sega ni wilikitaka tale. Kevaka e vakasegataki, ena tawana ga na kena ivakarau sa maroroi oti.
ext_admin_dex.shortfalls_description: E vakavolatani e vakalevu cake mai na ka e taura na itikotiko
ext_admin_dex.showing_n_of_n_swaps: E vakaraitaki tiko na {shown} ena {total} na swap e gadreva na kena kauaitaki.
ext_admin_dex.sign_blocked_until_accepted: Na sainitaki ena tarovi me yacova ni vakadonuya na ivakasala ni leqa.
ext_admin_dex.slippage_description: Na tolerance e vakayagataki, ena basis points. Oqo ga na inumera ena quote e vakaitavi kina na chain vakataki koya.
ext_admin_dex.slug_description: Na path segment e vakayagataki na aggregators kei na indexers me digitaka kina na chain oqo.
ext_admin_dex.sold_description: E vica na ka e volitaka na dauvakayagataka, ena token ni volitaki.
ext_admin_dex.standard_description: V2 se V3. Na isau ni V2 e sega ni rawa ni wasei tani mai na ilavo taumada ena chain.
ext_admin_dex.status_reason_description: Na vuna e vakaotia kina na veisau ni ilavo oqo ena vanua oqo.
ext_admin_dex.support_can_confirm_backup: You can see how many customers have confirmed their phrase, but not which ones, and not the phrase itself.
ext_admin_dex.support_cannot_recover: A lost recovery phrase cannot be recovered, by you or by us. There is no reset, no override and no support path — the encryption key never left the customer's browser.
ext_admin_dex.support_phrase_works_elsewhere: A customer who still has their phrase can restore the same wallet here or in MetaMask, Phantom, Tonkeeper or TronLink. The addresses and funds are unaffected by anything done on this platform.
ext_admin_dex.swap_chain_description: Na network e vakayagataki me vakauta kina na veisau oqo.
ext_admin_dex.swap_figures_unavailable: Na idusidusi ni swap e sega ni rawa
ext_admin_dex.swap_is_not_serving: E sega ni cakacaka na swap
ext_admin_dex.swap_status_description: Na vanua sa yacova kina na veisau oqo. Na ivakarau va ni sega ni taucoko era kena ibalebale duidui ka gadreva na isau duidui.
ext_admin_dex.swap_tx_description: Na ID ena chain. Tavuraka ki na explorer ni chain oya me rawa ni raici kina na veisau vakataki koya.
ext_admin_dex.swap_user_description: O cei e vakauta na veisau oqo.
ext_admin_dex.swap_user_email_description: Na email ni akaunede, me baleta na isau ni tikite.
ext_admin_dex.swap_user_name_description: Na yaca ni dauniyaga ni akaunede.
ext_admin_dex.swaps_page_description: Na veisau kece era sa vakauta na dauveiqaravi, kei na vanua e yacova kina. Na itukutuku ga, sega ni ivakarau ni veiliutaki — sa toso oti na ilavo ka sega ni dua na ka eke ena veisautaki na ka a yaco ena chain.
ext_admin_dex.sweep_failed: E sega ni rawa ni vakarautaki na sweep oya.
ext_admin_dex.sweep_moves_no_money: Na foomu oqo e sega ni vakayagataka e dua na ilavo ka sega tale ga ni rawa. Na cakacaka e sega ni taura tu na iyau ni fee-recipient nomu. Vakayacora taumada na veisau mai na nomu iwalibogi, qai biuta na transaction hash eke.
ext_admin_dex.sweep_not_mined: Se bera ni mine taki. Vakauta tale ni sa vakadeitaki.
ext_admin_dex.sweep_status_description: Na vanua e tu kina na fee oqo ena maliwa ni chain kei na nomu ripoti ni tubu.
ext_admin_dex.swept_30d_description: Sa vakayagataki ka tiko ena nomu ripoti ni tubu
ext_admin_dex.swept_into_books: Sa Sweep ki na Ivola ni Lavo
ext_admin_dex.taker_description: Na iwalibogi e vakadodonutaki kina na quote oqo.
ext_admin_dex.taker_verified_description: Ke a vakadinadinataka na taker na nona lewa na iwalibogi oya ena gauna e vakatavi kina na quote. Sa vakarautaki me vaka ga ni a tiko ena gauna oya, sega ni vaka ni tiko oqo.
ext_admin_dex.the_amm_deployment_key_uniswap_v2: Na iyau ni deployment ni AMM — uniswap-v2, uniswap-v3, pancake-v2.
ext_admin_dex.the_ammdeployment_key_uniswap_v2_uniswap: Na iyau ni AmmDeployment: uniswap-v2, uniswap-v3 se pancake-v2.
ext_admin_dex.the_confirmation_sweep_has_not_settled_t: Na sweep ni vakadeitaki e dodonu me sa vakaotia oqo me vakadeitaki se biu, o koya gona na ivakadinadina oqo e baleta na poller ka sega ni baleta na chain.
ext_admin_dex.the_platform_fee_is_0_bps: Na fee ni cakacaka e 0 bps, o koya gona e sega ni dua na ka e vakasoqoni ena so na vanua
ext_admin_dex.the_sweep_has_never_looked: Na sweep e se bera ni vakarautaka e dua na check.
ext_admin_dex.the_sweep_last_looked_n_ago: A qai vakadikevi otioqo e dua na swap se waraki ena {age} sa oti.
ext_admin_dex.the_transactions_description: Saini na veisau yadua mai na nomu wallet. Na risiti yadua e wilika tale mai eke ka vola mai na ka e tukuna na chain.
ext_admin_dex.these_need_an_operator_before_the_fee_is: Sa biu oqori na sweeper. E gadrevi e dua na operator ni bera ni rawa ni kauta tale na fee — na ilavo sa tu vata kei na dauvakawali ni fee, sa sega ni yali.
ext_admin_dex.this_screen_is_the_only_place_this_key_i: Oqo ga na sikirini e volai kina na isetting oqo — sa sega ni volai ena platform settings.
ext_admin_dex.this_sets_the_price: Na veisau oqo e vakatauyavutaka na isau
ext_admin_dex.this_sets_the_price_body: Sa lala na pool, ia e sega ni rawa ni veisau tale ka na wasede o solia ena isau dina. Na imatai ni arbitrageur ena taura na cala kece, ena imatai ni block, ka sega ni rawa ni veisau tale.
ext_admin_dex.token_address_description: Na itikotiko ni contract ena nona chain. E vakaraitaki vakadodonu me vaka ga e vakaoqoi kina — ena Solana, TRON kei na TON na vakalevui ni matavosa e tiki ni itikotiko.
ext_admin_dex.token_chain_description: Na network e tiko kina na token oqo.
ext_admin_dex.token_column_description: Na ticker ni token, kei na yacana taucoko e ruku.
ext_admin_dex.token_curation_group_description: Ke rawa ni veisautaki na token oqo, kei na cava e vakatulewataka.
ext_admin_dex.token_decimals_description: E wilikina mai na contract, sega ni vola. Ke cala na kena ivakarau eke ena vu ni dua na cala e tini na levu ena veiisau kece era raica na dauveiqaravi.
ext_admin_dex.token_notes_description: Ivola i loma. E sega ni vakaraitaki vei ira na dauveiqaravi.
ext_admin_dex.token_notes_group_description: Me baleta na nomu timi. E sega ni raici e so na vanua e rawa ni yacova kina e dua na dauveiqaravi.
ext_admin_dex.token_presentation_group_description: Na sala e basika kina na token ena swap picker.
ext_admin_dex.token_status_description: Na nomu switch: ke solia se sega totolo na token oqo.
ext_admin_dex.token_status_form_description: Ni Off e kauta laivi sara ga na token mai na picker. Na itukutuku makawa ni swap e se qai vakayacori tiko ena laini oqo.
ext_admin_dex.token_symbol_description: Na ticker me vaka e vakaraitaki ena swap picker.
ext_admin_dex.tokens_page_description: Na ka era rawa ni veisautaka na dauveiqaravi. E tolu na gate tautaki era vakatulewataka — na nomu switch, na nomu vakatulewa ni listing, kei na itukutuku ni automated screening — ka vakaraitaki vakayadua me kila kina o iko se cava e vakatawa na token.
ext_admin_dex.transaction_hash_help: Keimami dikeva ni taucoko vinaka na veisau oqo ka tiko kina e dua na veisau ni token oqo, mai na nomu dauvakawali ni fee, ki na vanua e cake.
ext_admin_dex.transaction_kind_description: Na swap, kei na approval kei na wrap era muri kina. Era vakaocataka na ledger vata na kavaruki ni ka e va, ni ratou vinakati vata na tracking ni vakadinadinataki.
ext_admin_dex.trending_form_description: Vakayagataka me baleta e dua na maketi o via kauta kina na vakasama ena macawa oqo.
ext_admin_dex.type_to_confirm_description: Na fee tier na kena taucoko ni yaviyavi ni nomu isau, ia ena pool lala na wasede o solia na isau dina. E rau vola tale me rau wilikina vakadua, vakatulewataki.
ext_admin_dex.unbookable_positions: {count} ena pools era sega ni rawa ni volai kina na nodra fee
ext_admin_dex.v2_fees_not_bookable: Na fee ni pool oqo e sega ni rawa ni volai
ext_admin_dex.v2_fees_not_bookable_body: Na pool vakataki Uniswap-V2 e vakaduavatataka na fee kei na icavuti se sega ni tiko e dua na ivakarau ena chain me vakatawaseyaki kina. Na isau e dina; ena vakaraitaki wale ga me vaka e dua na tu e tubu tiko.
ext_admin_dex.value_usd_description: E vakatauyavutaki na isau ena gauna ni swap. Na dash e kena ibalebale ni sega ni rawa ni keimami vakatauyavutaka na isau ni token oqo. Sa sega ni zero.
ext_admin_dex.valued_independently: E vakatauyavutaki me vaka na isau tautaki.
ext_admin_dex.venue_direct_only_warning: Na fill kece ena maketi oqo e lako mai na nomu pool, ka sega ni dua na aggregator e veitauvi kina.
ext_admin_dex.venue_kind_description: Se a lako oqo ena dua na aggregator se vakadodonu ki na pool.
ext_admin_dex.venue_policy_description: Na sala e digitaki kina na route ni maketi oqo. Na dua ga na tikina oqo e vakasavuya na vanua e lako kina na ilavo.
ext_admin_dex.venue_policy_form_description: Na 'Taukena' e muria na nomu 'global setting'. Na 'Vakadodonu Walega' e vakalako na fill kece ena nomu pool taucoko ka sega ni dua na aggregator e veitauvi kina — e dodonu ke nomu token, ia e sau levu ke dua na token bibi.
ext_admin_dex.verification_description: IVAKADINADINA e kena ibalebale ni keimami vakatauvatana na veisuvi ena ivakadinadina taucoko ni swap. VAKADEITAKI e kena ibalebale ni keimami vakadeitaka na levu ni ilavo mai na rate e quote-taki.
ext_admin_dex.verification_failed: Na ivakadinadina e sega ni rawa ni vakadinadinataki.
ext_admin_dex.verified_source_description: Na vanua e lako mai kina na kena itukutuku na token oqo.
ext_admin_dex.waiting_for_confirmation: E Waraka Tiko e Dua na Vakadonuya
ext_admin_dex.wallet_returned_no_hash: Na wallet e sega ni vakasuka e dua na transaction hash.
ext_admin_dex.what_actually_reaches_the_position_after: Na ka dina e yaco ki na position ni oti na kena tikiniwa na protocol ni venue, ena bps. Na vakasama e tara ena fee tier e vakalevutaka cake na income ena 17–20%.
ext_admin_dex.what_did_not_do_what_the_user_asked: Na swaps e sega ni cakava na ka e kerea na tamata vakayagataki, kei ira era sa yali ena sweep.
ext_admin_dex.what_each_chain_still_needs_and_what_it_: Na ka e se gadreva tiko e veichain me rawa ni vakayacora e dua na swap, kei na ka e kauta ena 24 na aua sa oti.
ext_admin_dex.what_support_can_do: What support can and cannot do
ext_admin_dex.what_the_swapper_pays_in_hundredths: Na ka e sauma na swapper, ena drau ni ivakarau ni bip. 3000 e 0.30%. E sega ni basis points.
ext_admin_dex.where_fees_live: Na fees ni swap ena sega ni tiko ena nomu profit report me yacova ni o sweep-i ira
ext_admin_dex.where_fees_live_body: Na fees era tubu cake ena chain ki na itikotiko ni fee-recipient o vakarautaka ena network yadua, sega ni ki na platform wallet. Na platform oqo e sega ni taura na key oya, o na vakayagataka kina o iko me kauta na ilavo ka volita na veisuvi eke; qai na gauna oya ga e yaco kina na revenue ki na nomu profit report.
ext_admin_dex.who_answered_who_was_signed_and_who_fail: O cei e sauma, o cei sa vakadinadinataki dina, kei o cei e sega ni rawa — ena 24 na aua sa oti.
ext_admin_dex.with_a_recipient_subtitle: Sa vakarautaki e dua na itikotiko ni fee
ext_admin_dex.wrapped_native_description: Na itikotiko ni token native vakaisuluti, e vakayagataki ena gauna e dodonu kina me lako na sala ena dua na tiki ERC-20.
ext_admin_dex.you_are_the_market: O ni sa maketi ena {count} ni veika oqo
ext_admin_dex.you_are_the_market_body: Ke cake ena ilawalawa ni vakalevu, na vuqa ni veivoli ena pool oya e wili kina o ni me isa ni veivoli — wili kina o ira na dau vakayagataki ni nomuni e daumada.

ext_hb.pure_market_making_and_cross_exchange: Pure market making and cross-exchange market making configs, rendered as YAML you drop straight into your install's conf/controllers/.
ext_hb.rotate_the_secret_for_this_key: Rotate the secret for this key? The old secret will stop working immediately.
ext_hb.run_it_inside_the_hummingbot_conda: Run it inside the Hummingbot conda environment — the verification step has to use the same interpreter the bot itself runs, or it can pass while Hummingbot still fails to import.
ext_hb.run_your_own_market_maker_on: Run your own market maker on
ext_hb.signed_and_enabled_nothing_to_do_here: Signed and enabled. Nothing to do here.
ext_hb.something_is_signing_requests_as_you_but: Something is signing requests as you, but
ext_hb.spot_and_perpetuals_market_data_and: Spot and perpetuals, market data and user data — the surface a market-making bot actually needs to quote both sides and manage inventory.
ext_hb.steps_1_and_2_are_proven: Steps 1 and 2 are proven, so the process has most likely exited on your machine — start it again.
ext_hb.the_bots_requests_start_failing_immediat: The bot's requests start failing immediately. Re-enable from the API Keys page whenever you want — the secret is not rotated, so nothing needs reconfiguring.
ext_hb.the_connector_kit_is_missing_from_this_d: The connector kit is missing from this deployment
ext_hb.the_exchange_hasnt_published_any_strateg: The exchange hasn't published any strategy presets. Check back later.
ext_hb.the_live_feed_above_is_unaffected: The live feed above is unaffected. Setup state is retried automatically; reload if it does not come back.
ext_hb.the_previous_secret_has_been_invalidated: The previous secret has been invalidated. Update your Hummingbot config now.
ext_hb.the_server_response_was_missing_the: The server response was missing the key or secret. No key was created — please retry.
ext_hb.the_server_response_was_missing_the_1: The server response was missing the new secret — please retry.
ext_hb.the_signing_secret_will_be_shown: The signing secret will be shown ONCE. Copy it immediately.
ext_hb.the_steps_below_are_still_correct: The steps below are still correct, but the live status badges are hidden rather than guessed at. This retries by itself.
ext_hb.then_watch_it_here_the_bot: Then watch it here — the bot console shows the quotes, fills and inventory it has on our books, live.
ext_hb.there_are_exactly_two_ways_this: There are exactly two ways this site can affect your bot, and you control both. The agent in step 5 relays only the eight commands Hummingbot's own console exposes, it runs only while you run it, and revoking its key ends that channel. Separately, the emergency stop on the bot console disables your API keys and cancels every resting order — it needs no agent, so it works even when nothing else does.
ext_hb.this_is_the_only_time_the: This is the only time the secret is visible. After closing this dialog you can rotate to mint a new one, but the old secret will be destroyed.
ext_hb.this_is_what_the_emergency_stop: This is what the emergency stop does. Re-enabling keeps the same secret, so nothing in your bot needs reconfiguring.
ext_hb.waiting_for_the_first_signed_request: Waiting for the first signed request from your bot. This line updates by itself — leave the page open while you start it.
ext_hb.watch_it_work_in_the_bot: Watch it work in the bot console — your ladder, your fills, your inventory, live from the moment the first order lands.
ext_hb.your_bot_is_reaching_us_and_being_refuse: Your bot is reaching us and being refused
ext_hb.your_bot_runs_on_your_machine: Your bot runs on your machine. These are the four things it needs from us — the connector package, a signed key, this exchange's URL, and a strategy. Step five is optional: run the agent and you can drive it from here too.
ext_hb.your_bot_runs_where_you_run: Your bot runs where you run it, and nothing about your strategy is stored on this side. You still get a window into it: quotes, fills and inventory live in your browser, with a stop button.
ext_hb.your_hummingbot_api_key_is_disabled: Your Hummingbot API key is disabled
ext_hb.your_hummingbot_does_not_know_this: Your Hummingbot does not know this exchange until its connector package is installed. Download it and run the installer.
ext_hb.your_keys_are_disabled_first_so: Your keys are disabled first, so the bot cannot replace the orders as they are pulled. Cancelling alone would achieve nothing — a market maker re-quotes within a second.
